rationale: Probe found a speech-led tutorial whose decisive facts live in short README, terminal, specification, directory, external image-generation, Finder, and browser UI states. Capture therefore combines OCR-dense reads with before/during/after sequences. The protocol separates observable state, file origin, human operations, external-tool state, file handoff, and the local-SPA delivery boundary, while leaving brands, continuity, timing, generated-file provenance, and untested functionality unknown unless shown.

captureActions.reason: Capture the three-hour, zero-code, reusable-template, and learnability claims and the accompanying example montage without conflating claims with proof.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Hook cards and example imagery; claims remain author claims unless independently demonstrated.

captureActions.reason: Read the first step and visible provider/API page transition.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Step-one framing and an API-key/provider interface; any secret values remain unread or redacted.

captureActions.reason: Recover the exact Claude Code installation text and whether execution is visibly shown.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Installation command and subsequent terminal state, with execution continuity stated only if the frames establish it.

captureActions.reason: The exact uv/Python/package command appears only briefly and was previously omitted.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Installation, run, and upgrade lines including exact command spelling; shown text must not be described as executed unless execution appears.

captureActions.reason: Capture the claimed compatibility/provider/model framing before configuration begins.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Narrated/onscreen claims about using Kimi K2 with Claude Code, retained as claims where not operationally proven.

captureActions.reason: Preserve the visible input/operation/output around API-key creation without exposing or inventing a token.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Before page, creation interaction, and resulting key/state; secret content remains unavailable.

captureActions.reason: Read endpoint, environment-variable names, token placeholder, model choice, and shell/terminal operation precisely.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Visible commands/parameters and terminal output; actual secret and unseen shell persistence remain unknown.

captureActions.carrier: Claude Code terminal UI + step card
captureActions.reason: Read the complete visible success state: version, model, billing label, user greeting, assistant reply, and transition to step two.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Claude Code v2.0.31, displayed K2-family model, API Usage Billing, hi/你好 exchange, and step-two framing where legible.

captureActions.reason: Screen text carries engineering requirements omitted by the concise narration.
captureActions.expectedObservation: HTML5 semantic structure, handwritten/vanilla CSS rather than Tailwind, glassmorphism details, ES6+ JavaScript, localStorage, GameEngine/time/scene/story-dialogue, protagonist values/feedback/failure endings, character data/interactions/details, UI and local SPA requirements, limited to legible lines.

captureActions.reason: Establish which folders/files already exist before implementation and which shown directories appear empty.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Read/list operations and visible state of story, characters, assets, gameplay, image_pipeline or neighboring entries; origin remains unknown unless shown.

captureActions.carrier: project documents and agent planning UI
captureActions.reason: Recover the project introduction, five male character records, status/action/schedule/random-event requirements, and the agent's read/plan boundary.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Visible document content and planning/read results; counts and details are reported only when legible.

captureActions.reason: Capture the transition from missing art to a separate unbranded image-generation interface.
captureActions.expectedObservation: An art-asset gap and a hard cut to an external UI; brand/model and session continuity remain unknown.

captureActions.reason: Observe four-variant grids, human selection, and save/download-like controls at high density.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Repeated result grids and visible human-operated controls; group counts are not inflated into unique deliverables and ambiguous icons stay ambiguous.

captureActions.reason: Read visible filenames and document the manual save/download/naming/placement state before handoff.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Finder files and filenames where legible; generation source and exact filesystem path remain unknown unless visible.

captureActions.reason: Preserve the observable human-to-file-to-agent chain and ensuing read/implementation request.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Local files are shown then supplied/referenced to the coding agent, which reads or implements; exact transport/path and prior origin remain bounded by visible evidence.

captureActions.reason: Read the run instruction and establish the deliverable as a local index.html browser SPA, not a released mobile or standalone game.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Instruction to open index.html in a browser and a local visual-novel-style preview with top HUD, characters/backgrounds/dialogue; hosting/release is not shown.

captureActions.reason: Capture visible character/background/dialogue examples, top status values, and the author's qualitative review while separating shown UI from tested systems.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Multiple preview states and author judgments about dialogue; save/load, bad endings, random events, character detail and responsive behavior remain untested unless operated.

captureActions.carrier: preview -> human prompt -> agent read/edit -> preview
captureActions.reason: Recover the complete revision chain and CSS/layout parameters rather than reporting only the improved result.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Old layout, human request, agent file read/edit and completion note, then changed preview; exact causal continuity is limited by hard cuts.

captureActions.reason: Capture the three genre examples, cross/check overlays, generalization claims, and request-for-document CTA without treating examples as delivered games.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Three illustrative genre images and CTA/claim text; universal beginner success remains unverified.

stoppingRules: Do not stop until carrierSweep covers 0.000–111.061 seconds without a gap or overlap.
Do not stop until every capture action whose mode is ocr_review or ui_state_review is included in the OCR manifest and its high-impact lines are visually verified against frames.
Do not stop until the Kimi CLI README command, Python version, package name, and any visible run/upgrade line are read or marked illegible.
Do not stop until Claude Code version, displayed model, API Usage Billing, hi input, and 你好 response are separately accounted for.

Do not stop until the specification's technical stack, local-SPA constraint, architecture, UI, NPC/character, value, schedule/action, storage and failure requirements are read or explicitly marked unknown.
Do not stop until pre-existing directory/file state, file origin, external generation UI, human save/download/naming/placement, and agent handoff are separated.
Do not stop until the local index.html browser boundary and every untested gameplay/release claim are explicit.
Do not stop until the layout revision has before, human instruction, during read/edit, agent report, and after evidence.
Do not stop until all 32 SRT cues have one cueAccountability row with exact cue text preserved and linked to a unit or context classification.
Do not stop until the AAC stereo track and the unresolved identity/role of non-speech audio are recorded without guessing.
Do not stop until all schema checks pass for probe, protocol, OCR evidence, and reconstruction.
declaredUnknowns: The exact API secret/token is not available and must not be reconstructed.
The external image-generation product, model, prompt, generation settings, and licensing are not established by the visible unbranded UI.
The provenance and creation time of project documents and populated assets that exist before the coding-agent read are unknown.
Hard-cut continuity does not establish that every terminal, document, asset, and preview belongs to one unchanged project version/session.
The video does not independently verify the three-hour duration, absolute zero-handwritten-code claim, or cross-genre beginner universality.
Save/load, bad endings, random events, character-detail behavior, responsive behavior, release packaging, mobile deployment, and standalone-game status are not tested in the shown preview.
Signal inspection cannot reliably identify a distinct music or sound-effect source or its narrative role apart from speech/stereo mixture.
